caption: The video captures two crested, red-vented bulbul-like birds perched side by side on a thin diagonal wire against a blurred grayish-brown wall. Both display black crested heads, white cheek patches, pale breasts, dark wings, red undertail coverts, and white-tipped tails hanging downward. The left bird sits slightly lower on the wire. Throughout the excerpt the left bird rotates its head and crest, shifting them from an up-left orientation to an up-right orientation facing its companion, with the crest returning to upright partway through, while its body and feet remain fixed. For most of the clip the right bird holds its head turned left, beak aimed at the other bird, with a low, rounded crown. Toward the end of the excerpt the right bird raises its black crest into a tall sharp point and turns its head and upper body so its white cheek patch and pale breast face more toward the camera. Neither bird walks, hops, or flies along the wire, and their perch positions and hanging tails stay unchanged.
relations: Left bird's head and crest rotate from up-left toward up-right facing companion, while body and feet stay fixed on wire.
Right bird keeps head turned left with low crown, then raises crest sharply and rotates upper body toward camera.
Both birds' hanging tails and perch positions remain unchanged throughout the head and crest movements.
